lines.zh: 我吊在半空，晃起来像一块玉。
lines.en: I hang in the air and swing like a piece of jade.
A little light comes through the pale blue shell.

lines.zh: 风推我，我就往另一边荡。
lines.en: The wind pushes and I swing the other way.
My thread is thin and long.
I have no legs. I cannot walk.
The wind at the leaf edge carried me aside.
I turn by degrees toward the light.

lines.zh: 枝条弯曲，我也跟着低下去。
lines.en: The branch bends and I dip with it.

lines.zh: 我被风推着撞了一下叶柄。
lines.en: The wind swung me into the stem.

lines.zh: 我悬在离地一人高的地方。
lines.en: I hang a man's height above the ground.
I swing slowly, like breathing.

lines.zh: 我隔着壳看外面，都是蓝的。
lines.en: Through my shell the world looks blue.
I hang and wait for the wind to stop.
Leaf shadows slide across my shell.
I am slowly warmed by the sun.
I swing and do nothing.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，外面是淡蓝的。
lines.en: Inside the shell, everything outside is pale blue.

lines.zh: 壳已经薄得能看见影子。
lines.en: The shell is thin enough to show shadows.
The wings lie tight against each other.
I am counting the warm days left.

lines.zh: 露水在我壳上滚成一粒。
lines.en: Dew beads on my shell.

lines.zh: 有一只蝶落在旁边的叶上。
lines.en: A butterfly landed on the next leaf.
It stayed a while, then flew off.

lines.zh: 我知道我以后会是什么样子。
lines.en: I know what I will look like.

lines.zh: 我的壳被日光照得发亮。
lines.en: The sunlight makes my shell shine.
It is crowded and quiet in here.
I hear water below the tree.

lines.zh: 这个角度，看得见整条枝。
lines.en: From this angle I can see the whole branch.
You put your head under the leaf.
My shell stands out in the light.
You look at me like a bead.
Do not pinch. It would break.
I have only one thread.
Do not blow at my shell.
Whoever is with you is looking too.
I am here and cannot move.
When I open you will understand.

lines.zh: 你现在看到的是壳，不是我。
lines.en: What you see is the shell, not me.
There is a crack across the shell.
I swing hard and everything goes white.
That blow left me dull and aching.
A wing folded wrong inside.
The thread has stretched.
I steady slowly.
The shell still hangs, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我疼得说不出，反正也说不出。
lines.en: It hurts, and I could not say so anyway.

lines.zh: 有一点东西从缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Something seeps from the seam.
I draw in tighter.
No mouth in this shell. I cannot eat.
That sweet smell comes through.
I can only smell it.

lines.zh: 你把花放在叶子边上吧。
lines.en: Put the flower at the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 等出来以后，我会去找花。
lines.en: When I am out I will go looking for flowers.

lines.zh: 现在这些东西，都用不上。
lines.en: None of this is of use now.
I smelled it through the shell a long while.

lines.zh: 甜味让我在里面动了动。
lines.en: The sweetness made me stir inside.
Take it away. Not so close.
I will need this later.

lines.zh: 你碰了枝条，我晃成一片。
lines.en: You touched the branch and I swung wide.
The shell is thin. A touch leaves a white mark.
I turned several times before stopping.
Do not flick me.
I am coming loose. Hold on.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在叶柄上，很响。
lines.en: That knocked the stem. It was loud.
The leaf and I swing together.
Step back and the wind eases.
I am fine. The shell is whole.
You blocked the wind and I stopped.
Two other shells hang nearby.
One pale green, one all black.

lines.zh: 我们的丝都挂在同一根枝上。
lines.en: Our threads all hang from the same branch.
We cannot see each other's faces.
A leaf has fallen against its shell.

lines.zh: 我们三个都在等同一件事。
lines.en: All three of us wait for the same thing.
The day we open must be fair.

lines.zh: 到时候我们朝三个方向飞。
lines.en: Then we will fly in three directions.

lines.zh: 这样挂着的时候，我们是同类。
lines.en: While hanging like this we are the same kind.
Afterward, not anymore.

lines.zh: 有一片花瓣落在我丝上。
lines.en: A petal caught on my thread.

lines.zh: 我甩了一下，它掉下去了。
lines.en: I swung and it fell.
I cannot reach anything.

lines.zh: 露水滑到我壳上，又滑下去。
lines.en: Dew ran down my shell and off.
Something bright is moving below.
This one thread is all I have.
That little thing snagged on me.
It has not fallen. It is still there.
I cannot keep hold of anything.
When my wings open I will go and pick it up.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸吹动了我头顶的叶子。
lines.en: His breath stirs the leaf above me.

lines.zh: 他抬头，看见了亮的东西。
lines.en: He looked up and saw something bright.
That light is on my shell.
He is coming over.
He pushed the leaves aside.
I am completely exposed.
His fingers halted in the air.
He hesitated a moment.
He changed his angle and looked again.
He withdrew his hand and left.
He moved round the other side of the tree.
He looks up from below.
I let the light through and cannot hide.
He is judging my height.
He picked up a long stick.
He extends the stick toward me.
The stick touched my thread.
He begins to coax me down.

lines.zh: 树枝拨动丝线，我转个不停。
lines.en: The branch jostles my thread, and I keep spinning.
He stopped suddenly.

lines.zh: 我用湿翅膀顶了顶蓝壳壁。
lines.en: I push the blue shell wall with my damp wings.
The seam made a small sound.
I press the shell wall with my wings.
That loosened the shell a little.
He touched me, so I knock back.

lines.zh: 我的力气都被壳挡住了。
lines.en: The shell absorbs all my strength.
I push again, faintly.
A thin split opens at the shell's edge.
I stop. I cannot catch a breath.

lines.zh: 这已经是我能做的全部。
lines.en: That is everything I can do.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶背，壳是淡蓝的。
lines.en: I hang under a leaf in a pale blue shell.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶隙落在我身上。
lines.en: Sun comes through a gap in the leaves onto me.
This thread is finer than a hair.

lines.zh: 我被吊在离地很高的地方。
lines.en: I hang high above the ground.
There are flowers below, not yet open.
Something moved inside me.
The vein shadows fall across my shell.

lines.zh: 丛林里到处是这种声音。
lines.en: The jungle is full of this sound.
I am slowly growing brighter.
And so I hung for several days.
The heat made the shell brittle.
The thread broke and I fell into dead leaves.

lines.zh: 水从叶上流下来，把我泡住。
lines.en: Water ran off the leaf and soaked me.
The blast tore the leaf in two.
A sharp thing pierced the shell.
Strange light made the shell like glass.
There is nothing left inside the shell.

lines.zh: 雷一响，我整个人都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder froze me entirely.

lines.zh: 叶子消失了，我在往下掉。
lines.en: The leaf vanished and I am falling.
